description: Three canonical focus-ring recipes. Every recipe satisfies WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 (Focus Not Obscured) and SC 2.4.13 (Focus Appearance).

outer.description: Default. 2px solid outline offset outward from element.
outer.use: Buttons, inputs, chips, cards, most interactive surfaces.

inner-outer.description: 2px inner ring (element-matching) + 2px outer ring (accent). Used when the element sits on a surface that could match the default ring color.
inner-outer.cssTemplate: outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color); outline-offset: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-ring-color-outer);
inner-outer.use: Buttons on colored banners, chips in toolbar with contrasting edges, menu items.

inset.description: Inset outline for elements that cannot paint outside their bounds.
inset.use: Full-width list items, iframes, elements with parent overflow:hidden.
inset.note: Prefer outer; use inset only when outer paint would be clipped.

onTintedSurface.note: Swap to high-contrast neutral when surface tint may collide with accent.

prefersContrast.note: Escalate ring thickness and use system color under prefers-contrast: more.

forcedColors.rule: Rely on `outline: 2px solid CanvasText`. All custom ring colors are ignored by Forced Colors mode — do not fight the UA.

selector.reason: Avoids showing focus ring on pointer click for elements that don't need it (buttons). Keyboard users still see it.

refusedPatterns: outline: none without replacement — strips SC 2.4.11.
box-shadow alone — clipped by parent overflow; paint-order issues.
color-only focus (e.g., background-color change) — fails on tinted surfaces.
Dotted 1px outline — antialiasing noise, fails 2px minimum.
